user.title: User
user.description: Represents a small business owner registered in Namma NyayaMitra.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

email.description: The email address linked to the user account.

displayName.description: The user's display name or proprietor name.

firmName.description: The name of the user's MSME or business firm.

joinedAt.description: ISO timestamp representing user registration date.

onboarded.description: Indicates whether the user has finished their onboarding registration.

stakeholderType.description: What type of stakeholder role (e.g. Proprietor, Freelancer, Vendor).

nativeLanguage.description: The user's primary spoken native language selected during onboarding.

businessCategory.description: Small business or manufacturing sector domain.

stakeholderIntent.description: What the user wants to accomplish mainly with Namma NyayaMitra.

locationState.description: The state geolocation of the user e.g. Karnataka.

msmeCategory.description: The MSME size classification of the business.

startupStage.description: Starting stage of the micro project.

contractPreference.description: Whether simple or detailed agreements are preferred.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: Represents a scanned and processed legal contract review.

id.description: Unique identifier of the analysis record.

userId.description: Reference to the owner user's UID.

fileName.description: Name of the uploaded contract file or image.

documentType.description: The category ID of the scanned document e.g. 'vendor', 'rental'.

partiesInvolved.description: List of companies or individuals detected.

riskFlags.description: Detail list of potential legal traps and risk conditions.

analyzedAt.description: Date & time of this scanning request.

contract.title: Contract
contract.description: A customized drafted agreement document generated from form inputs.

id.description: Unique Identifier of the generated contract draft.

userId.description: Reference identifier to the creator user UID.

documentTitle.description: Formal header title of the deed.

plainEnglishSummary.description: Bilingual visual summary description in English.

hindiSummary.description: Bilingual visual summary description in Hindi.

keyProtections.description: List of core protections embedded into the contract draft.

formValues.description: Key-value dictionary parameters of input values used.

appointment.title: Appointment
appointment.description: Represents a scheduled lawyer consultation booking.

chat.title: Chat Message
chat.description: Represents a message sent to a verified lawyer in consultation.

/users/{userId}.description: Private registry of MSME proprietors profiles.

/analyses/{analysisId}.description: Individual contract scans, accessible only by the respective owner user.

/contracts/{contractId}.description: Document draft records created by users, private and secure.

/appointments/{appId}.description: Upcoming and historic booked lawyer consultation meetings.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Direct consultation messages threaded with lawyer partners.
